facts.value: The Employment Agency offers support for answering career orientation questions.
Goethe University offers career coaching to help students develop their individual profile and career orientation.
The Career Service offers feedback on the first impression of application documents.
Career Service staff helps students review completeness, clarity, and structure of application documents.

The application document check addresses questions such as how to write an attractive cover letter, how to align a job advertisement with application documents, how to present individual competencies in the cover letter, and how to showcase work experiences.
The International Career Service offers workshops, lectures, and counseling for international students.
The Career Service provides a counseling calendar for students to overview all counseling services and schedule appointments.
The Frankfurt Counseling Network, which includes Goethe University, provides support for students with doubts about their studies.
